insight: Formerly Sim Studio; its Figma-like canvas wires LLMs to 1,000+ tools and ships a workflow as an API, schedule, webhook, or chat app.
name: Sim
tagline: Open-source visual builder to create, deploy, and orchestrate AI agents.
description: An open-source workspace for building AI agents on a Figma-like drag-and-drop canvas, conversationally, or in code. It connects LLMs to 1,000+ integrations plus knowledge bases and structured tables, then deploys a workflow as an API, scheduled job, webhook handler, or standalone chat app. Apache-2.0, YC-backed, and runnable in Sim's cloud or self-hosted via npm or Docker.

modelSupport.notes: Connects to every major LLM provider and 1,000+ tool integrations.

edge: Figma-like canvas plus natural-language Copilot flow generation on a modern TS stack — ships a flow as API, cron, webhook, or chat.
pros: Clean visual canvas, cleaner than Flowise/Langflow
Copilot generates flows from natural language
Deploys as API, schedule, webhook, or chat app
cons: Self-host still needs a Copilot API key from sim.ai
Younger, smaller integration library than n8n
Less mature knowledge-base tooling than Dify

references.title: Flowise vs Langflow vs n8n vs Sim Studio: Visual Agent Builder Comparison 2026
